ready.body:
FIX ROUND 2 (FIX-Q1-125, agent 125) — growth-project-backend#785 @ 39865147daa2859225a5d7349620b2364ff16d32 — READY FOR DELTA AUDIT

Fixes A-785-1 and A-785-2 from the GPT-6.1 Sol verdict at f64275e4. Both were CI failures caused by the PR; the Sol lens found no B. Delta f64275e4..39865147 is one commit: 6 files, +54/-47. PR total +294/-59 = 353 changed lines. No change to the PR's behaviour.

**A-785-2: Banned cast tokens (R75 / R100.A2)** (was net +1 `as any`, +2 `as unknown as`, +6 `as never`)
- `src/auth/auth.service.ts`: a private `anonAuthClient()` is now the single anon-key client construction for `forgotPassword` and `resendVerification`. The existing `WS as any` transport line moved into it, so the net change is 0. The transport, keys and redirects are unchanged.
- `test/hunt02-auth-recovery.spec.ts`:
  - The ExecutionContext double is a typed `ExecutionContextHost`, the same pattern as test/wearables/wearables-throttle-isolation.spec.ts.
  - The AuthService doubles use the `asCtorArgs` + reasoned `@ts-expect-error` pattern from test/invite-attach-reliability.spec.ts.
  - `resendVerification` is called directly, with no cast.
- Checker at this head: `as any +27 -27 net 0 ... OK — no positive token change`, https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/actions/runs/37533122638

**A-785-1: build-and-test.** Four specs pinned the pre-PR contract and now match the PR's intended limits:
- `test/invite-attach-reliability.spec.ts`: the codeless baseline is read from `THROTTLER_ROUTE_LIMITS.AUTH_SIGNUP_PER_HOUR` (100 by default) and hammered with baseline+1. It still proves the code-bearing and codeless buckets are independent, a malformed code never unlocks the burst bucket, and the 40-patient clinic case holds.
- `test/rate-limit.spec.ts`: auth-login-per-min is 60 and auth-signup is 100 (config table and handler metadata for register and signup-with-code). Bootstrap-owner keeps 5/hour, pinned in hunt02-auth-recovery.spec.ts.
- `test/throttler-isolation.spec.ts`: POST /auth/register allows 100 per hour and the 101st gets 429.
- `test/dunning-v2-lockout-allowlist-route-table.spec.ts`: `auth/resend-verification` is added to the reviewed reachable set. It is a public, anonymous recovery route like `auth/forgot-password`.
- Result: build-and-test green, 895 suites, 15721 tests passed, https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/actions/runs/37533122516 . The five touched specs PASS in that log.

All other checks are green at this head: danger, npm audit, schema parity, RLS floor/live, community and MWB live tests, test-deploy-readiness, CodeQL.

The PR's own B-HUNT02-1 and B-HUNT02-2 and its tests are unchanged. No dependency, lockfile, migration or flag change. Nothing merged or deployed, and no provider call. Needs both backend T4 lenses at this exact head.
